prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a production-ready cartoon cat avatar PNG for an Electron desktop chat app, one single asset. Primary request: Create a distinct recognizable cat breed head portrait. Style: polished friendly 2D cartoon illustration, confident clean thick contours, flat warm natural fur colors with very subtle cel shading, simplified high contrast shapes that remain legible at 22, 34 and 56 CSS pixels, sophisticated rather than childish, consistent sticker icon family. Composition: square 512x512 canvas if possible; ONLY the cat head with BOTH ears and cheek tufts fully visible, facing forward, centered, occupying about 88 percent of canvas, no body, no paws. Fully transparent background, no circular disk or colored plate, no scenery. A thin light warm outer rim for readability on both black and white UI. Expressive large eyes. No text, labels, letters, numbers, watermark, props, clothing, accessories, glasses or collars. Not a photograph, not a 3D sphere, not emoji glyphs. Subject: Bombay cat: sleek nearly black short fur, wide rounded cheeks, upright rounded triangular ears, very large warm amber eyes, small charcoal nose. Use warm charcoal highlights and a subtle cream outer rim so the black silhouette remains visible on dark UI.
